standard.summary: LISA 每步只激活一部分 LoRA 层进行训练（按重要性采样），减少每步显存和计算开销，同时保持全层训练的效果。
standard.effect: lisa_active_ratio=0.2 表示每步只激活 20% 的 LoRA 层。显存和速度改善约 50-70%，质量损失约 2-5%。
standard.whenToUse: 显存紧张但想训练全层时。大模型（FLUX/SD3）上效果更明显。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存充足时不需要——全层同时训练效果最好。

standard_en.summary: LISA activates only a subset of the LoRA layers each step (sampled by importance), cutting per-step memory and computation while keeping the effect of training every layer.
standard_en.effect: lisa_active_ratio=0.2 activates 20% of the LoRA layers each step. Memory and speed improve by roughly 50-70% for a quality loss of about 2-5%.
standard_en.whenToUse: When VRAM is tight but you want every layer trained. The effect is more pronounced on large models (FLUX/SD3).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed when VRAM is plentiful -- training all layers together works best.

advanced.principle: 每 N 步（lisa_interval）根据梯度范数采样最重要的 active_ratio 比例的层，只对这些层执行 forward/backward/update。其余层的梯度累积到下一步。类似 dropout 但是在层级别。
advanced.intervention: 在 training_step 中动态选择活跃的 LoRA 层子集。
advanced.expectedImpact: 显存节省与 active_ratio 成正比。质量损失在 ratio >= 0.2 时可控。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 gradient_checkpointing 组合可进一步降低显存。

advanced_en.principle: Every N steps (lisa_interval), samples the most important active_ratio fraction of layers by gradient norm and runs forward/backward/update only on those. The other layers' gradients accumulate to the next step. Like dropout but at layer level.
advanced_en.intervention: Dynamically selects the active LoRA-layer subset in training_step.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: VRAM savings proportional to active_ratio. Quality loss is controllable at ratio >= 0.2.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Combines with gradient_checkpointing for further VRAM reduction.
